to: Determine on a non-saturating DV logged over training how contrastive-negative design controls bystander marker leakage along three axes: (1) the number of negatives (examples/persona and number of negative personas); (2) the distance of negatives to the source and of each held-out bystander to the nearest negative; and (3) the placement geometry — whether negatives suppress leakage as a barrier (a shell around the source: leakage rises with distance-to-source controlling for distance-to-nearest-negative) or a bubble (a local ball around each negative: leakage falls with distance-to-nearest-negative controlling for distance-to-source), all net of the base-model persona prior, with barrier-vs-bubble identified via multiple matched-count negative-placement arms.
